r: How did you manage to lose this? [Gives Throdna the second piece of the Kazaul ritual]

dds_throdna_100.m: I didn't say that! There was a traveler a long time back - he wrote a book Calomyran Secrets. It has the chant of passage, among other things to counter Kazaul dangers. Find it, if you can.
r: Calomyran Secrets? That rings a bell. Thanks!

dds_throdna_102.m: ... Ah, the anciente scriptura, perhaps it reveals the secret to rekindling the divine ...

dds_throdna_20.m: Why did you steal this? You must be part of that terrible cult of the Kazaul.

dds_throdna_22a.m: O Kazaul, venerabilis deus, where art thou in the shadows of tempus ...

dds_throdna_22b.m: ... Sacra ritus, anciente, must be reawakened, sed obscure ...

dds_throdna_22c.m: ... Lumen in tenebris, the sigil of Kazaul, lost in the mists of memoria ...

dds_throdna_24.m: ... Perhaps the incantatio of the ancients holds the key, sed forgotten ...
r: What was the word again? Ah, I remember. [Loud voice] Kazaul Est!

dds_throdna_32.m: So, you're not the one who stole my notes?
r: No, in fact I helped purify the shrine.

dds_throdna_40.m: That is right. So, what do you want?
r: I need to know what all this chant can do.

dds_throdna_50.m: It's a powerful chant for many dangerous things. I'm not sure I should tell. Followers of Kazaul want to get a foothold in Dhayavar.

dds_throdna_52.m: The ritual of the nocturnus, should it be performed under Luna's watchful eye ...

dds_throdna_54.m: ... Ego dubito, whether the offerings still hold power, or are but relics of a bygone era ...

dds_throdna_60.m: Yes. This piece of the ritual is of Kazaul. Along with the first part, one can raise Kazaul monsters, use in sacrifices, make defensive walls, impenetrable barriers ... dangerous rites.
r: I just came from such an impenetrable barrier in the south of Stoutford.

dds_throdna_70.m: An impenetrable barrier? That's no good. If Kazaul gains a foothold in Dhayavar, strong monsters will roam in Dhayavar.

dds_throdna_72.m: ... Is the tempus ripe for the reawakening of Kazaul, or is it but an illusion ...

dds_throdna_74.m: ... Must find the correct verba, the sacred words that summon the divine ...

dds_throdna_78.m: ... Kazaul's essence, hidden within the arcana of the old scrolls, waiting to be uncovered ...

dds_throdna_80.m: Eh, yes. The barrier. One has to use the two pieces of the ritual and a chant of passage to go through the barrier.
r: What is the chant of passage?

dds_throdna_90.m: That is something I do not know.

throdna_1.m: Kazaul ... Shadow ... what was it again?

throdna_10.m: The ritual. We believe that Kazaul will manifest in our presence soon.

throdna_11.m: We must learn more about the Kazaul ritual, to gain its power and learn to use it for our purposes.
r: Can I help in some way?
What were you planning to do?

throdna_12.m: As I said, we want to learn more about the ritual itself.

throdna_13.m: A while ago, we were on the verge of getting our hands on the whole ritual itself, but the messenger was killed under most interesting circumstances while traveling up here.

throdna_14.m: We knew he had the parts of the complete ritual on him, but since he was killed and we could not get to him because of the monsters - his notes were lost to us.

throdna_15.m: According to our sources, there should be five parts of the ritual scattered across the mountain. Three of them describing the ritual itself, and two describing the Kazaul chant used to summon the guardian.

throdna_16.m: Hmm, maybe you could be of use here...
r: I would be glad to help.
Sounds dangerous, but I'll do it.
Keep your ritual of the Shadow to yourself. I am not getting involved in this.

throdna_17.m: Fine, we will just have to find someone else then.

throdna_18.m: Yes, you might be able to help. Not that you really have any choice though.

throdna_19.m: OK. Find me the pieces of the ritual that the former messenger carried on him. They should be found somewhere on the path up to Blackwater mountain.
r: I will return with your parts of the ritual.

throdna_2.m: Oh, a visitor. Hello there. I have not seen you around here before. Did they let you in here?

throdna_3.m: Of course they did. What am I rambling on about. Harlenn and his gang always keep their worldly duties under control.

throdna_4.m: So, who might you be then, eh? Probably here to bother me with some worldly complaint about the settlement needing more resources or someone complaining about the cold drag from the outside again?

throdna_5.m: And there you go with your mundane problems. I tell you, your worldly troubles do not interest me the least bit.

throdna_6.m: This is the mages' chamber in Blackwater mountain. We devote our time to the studies of the Shadow and its descendants.
r: Let's go back to my other questions.

throdna_7.m: I am Throdna. One of the most learned persons around, if you ask me.

throdna_8.m: Kazaul, the Shadow spawn of red marrow.

throdna_9.m: We have been trying to read all we can on Kazaul, and the ritual. It seems we might be too late.

throdna_check_fail.m: It seems you have not found all five pieces yet.

r: What was that you talked about when I arrived, Kazaul?
Are you aware that there is a bitter rivalry going on between this settlement and Prim?

throdna_purify_1.m: Hello again. I hope you are here to tell me you have purified the shrine of Kazaul?
r: What was I supposed to do again?

throdna_purify_2.m: Then hurry and go take the vial to the shrine! What are you standing around here for?

throdna_purify_3.m: Good. We must hurry to continue our research on Kazaul.

throdna_purify_4.m: You should get out of here to allow us to concentrate on our work.

throdna_purify_7.m: [Throdna continues to mumble on about Kazaul, but you cannot make out any other words]

throdna_return_1.m: Hello again. I hope you come here to tell me you have the five parts of the ritual.
r: I am still looking for them.
How many parts was I supposed to find?
What was I supposed to do again?
Yes, I think I have found them all.

throdna_return_10.m: Second, we need you to take a vial of purifying spirit and apply it to the shrine.

throdna_return_11.m: This vial is a vial of purifying spirit. It should delay the process well enough for us to be able to continue our research.
r: Sounds dangerous, but I will do it.
This sounds like a trap. I won't agree to do your dirty work.

throdna_return_12.m: Good, here is the vial. Now hurry.

throdna_return_13.m: Return to me as soon as you have completed your task.

throdna_return_2.m: Then hurry and go find them! What are you standing around here for then?

throdna_return_3.m: You actually found all five pieces? I suppose I should thank you. Well then. Thank you.

throdna_return_4.m: We have more pressing matters to focus on. As I briefly mentioned before, we believe that Kazaul will manifest in our presence soon.

throdna_return_5.m: If that were to happen, we could not complete our research about the ritual or Kazaul itself, all our efforts would be lost.

throdna_return_6.m: Therefore, we intend to delay the process as much as we can, until we have learned of its powers.

throdna_return_7.m: You might be useful to us here again.
r: What do you need of me?
I sure hope it involves more killing and looting.

throdna_return_8.m: We need you to do two things. First, you must find the shrine of Kazaul. Our scouts tell us that the shrine should be located somewhere near the base of Blackwater mountain.

throdna_return_9.m: However, all passageways to the shrine are 'clouded in Shadow' according to our scouts. I'm not sure what that means.

kazaul.8: I have made my way into the inner chamber in the Blackwater mountain settlement and found a group of mages led by a man named Throdna.
kazaul.9: Throdna seems very interested in someone (or something) called Kazaul, and in particular a ritual performed in its name.
kazaul.10: I have agreed to help Throdna find out more about the ritual itself, by looking for pieces of the ritual that apparently are scattered across the mountain. I should go look for the parts of the Kazaul ritual on the mountain path down from Blackwater mountain to Prim.
kazaul.11: I need to find the two parts of the chant and the three pieces describing the ritual itself, and return to Throdna once I have found them all.
kazaul.21: I have found the first half of the chant for the Kazaul ritual.
kazaul.22: I have found the second half of the chant for the Kazaul ritual.
kazaul.25: I have found the first piece of the Kazaul ritual.
kazaul.26: I have found the second piece of the Kazaul ritual.
kazaul.27: I have found the third piece of the Kazaul ritual.
kazaul.30: Throdna thanked me for finding all the pieces of the ritual.
kazaul.40: Throdna wants me to put an end to the Kazaul spawn uprising that has taken place near the Blackwater mountain. There is a shrine at the base of the mountain that i should investigate closer.
kazaul.41: I have been given a vial of purifying spirit that Throdna wants me to apply to the shrine of Kazaul. I should return to Throdna when I have found and purified the shrine.
kazaul.50: In the shrine at the base of Blackwater mountain, I met a guardian of Kazaul. By reciting the verses of the ritual chant, I was able to make the guardian attack me.
kazaul.60: I have purified the shrine of Kazaul.
kazaul.100: I had expected some form of appreciation from Throdna for helping him learn more about the ritual and for purifying the shrine. But he seemed more occupied with rambling on about Kazaul. I could not make out anything sane from his ramblings.

darkness_in_daylight.10: I met Miri in the Crossroads Guardhouse.
darkness_in_daylight.20: Since I had helped Ailshara, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.30: Since I had hidden the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.40: Since I had aided Feygard once or twice earlier, she would tell me about Andor, after I had completed an investigation for her.
darkness_in_daylight.50: Since Miri was poisoned by slitherers near Sullengard, and healing is taking time, she wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the strange areas to the south of Stoutford.
darkness_in_daylight.60: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford and encountered an impassable force there.
darkness_in_daylight.70: There was a piece of Kazaul ritual there, which I had encountered before. I should inform Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.80: Miri asked me where I had seen this before. I told her about a task I had carried out on behalf of Throdna of the Blackwater settlement.
darkness_in_daylight.90: Miri told me to meet him and enquire further. And gave me a phrase to use whenever he started rambling.
darkness_in_daylight.100: Throdna told me it was part of a ritual to break the barrier which forms when one does a ritual to call strong Kazaul monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.110: The ritual consisted of two parts which I had found earlier, and a chant in a book called Calomyran Secrets. I need to report this to Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.120: I told Miri about finding the book for an Old Man in Fallhaven.  She told me to talk to him.
darkness_in_daylight.130: The Old Man would not let me borrow the book, so I started noting the chant in front of him.
darkness_in_daylight.140: The book contained half the chant. The rest was to be found in another book Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.150: Miri told me she'd trace the book. She told me to wait for her return.
darkness_in_daylight.160: Miri came back and told me that the book Azimyran Secrets was with an old hermit near Arulir mountain.
darkness_in_daylight.170: I met the old hermit and asked him about the book, Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.180: He refused to give it to me, so I copied the chant sitting with him. I needed to tell Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.190: Miri told me to hurry, and pass the barrier.
darkness_in_daylight.198: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
darkness_in_daylight.200: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
darkness_in_daylight.210: Miri, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayavar with Kazaul's monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.220: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest who walks on lava east of the Purple Hills.
darkness_in_daylight.230: We let the mourning woman go.
darkness_in_daylight.232: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
darkness_in_daylight.240: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
darkness_in_daylight.250: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
darkness_in_daylight.260: He accused me of interfering. Miri, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
darkness_in_daylight.280: Miri fulfilled her promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his food supplies at Rosmara's food stand.
darkness_in_daylight.300: Indeed, I have found Andor there.
darkness_in_daylight.310: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
